description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the ConnectionPersistenceActor class, which manages connection persistence, command handling, subscription management, and message forwarding within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging service. The tests verify behaviors related to connection lifecycle, message handling, error handling, reconnection strategies, and acknowledgements.
